{"id":"mimid-1wgh.61","title":"A new device joins its user's rooms by external Commit; rooms from Chat.roomId; member and admin get canAddOwnClient","description":"Bead mimid-d464: a user's new device must end up in the rooms the user is already in. Two readings:

(a) An existing device of the user commits an Add of the new device's KeyPackage in each room. It needs a way to learn of the new device (KeyMaterial/fetch for its own user, or the provider telling it) and an existing device online. KeyMaterial/fetch is "to add the target user" (protocol-07 §5.2); the hub authorizes it by canAddParticipant (decision mimid-1wgh.6.20), and the answer consumes a one-time KeyPackage of every client of the user, the asking device's own included. No draft describes this flow; the trigger would be mimid's own invention.

(b) The new device joins each room by external Commit (RFC 9420 §12.4.3.2) after GroupInfo/fetch (protocol-07 §5.6). protocol-07 §3.6 ("Cathy adds a new device") and §5.6 case a) describe exactly this; draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §Room/create says "The owner's other clients join the room by external join ({{groupinfo-fetch}}), as any new client of a participant does", §Room/update accepts the external Commit, and §Chat.roomId lists the account's rooms (Chat/get), so the new device learns the rooms from its own server. mimid-server already implements GroupInfo/fetch, the hub's /groupInfo and external Commits.

Chosen: (b). It needs no invention and no other device online.

Details:
1. Rooms: the roomId of every Chat of the account (Chat/get, ids null, properties roomId). Bound and unbound Chats look alike (the draft gives no flag), so every room this device does not already know is tried; a room it knows (active, leaving or left) is never tried.
2. GroupInfoRequest: a fresh Ed25519 key per request and a BasicCredential with the user URI, like the KeyMaterialRequest (mimi-mls's Identity does not hand out the MLS signing key; the hub does not correlate the request with the Commit, decision mimid-1wgh.6.14, and requires a BasicCredential user URI, step 3 of hub/group_info.rs). A did_webvh device asks the same way. groupInfoPublicKey is a fresh X25519 key (mimi-mls label::HpkePrivateKey::generate).
3. Checks before the Commit is sent: GroupInfoSuccess::verify, room_id is the room asked for, the GroupInfo's external_senders contains the response's hub_sender (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §GroupInfo/fetch SHOULD), a room_metadata room_uri if present equals the room, and the group already has a leaf of this user. The last is mimid's own rule: the server makes a Chat for a Welcome nobody accepted, and without it the new device would join a room the user's invite policy left pending. The external Commit is then already merged locally (Member::join_external); a room that fails a check is dropped without sending and its group state is left unused in mls.sqlite.
4. A GroupInfo with pending proposals is not joined now: the hub refuses an external Commit while proposals are pending (hub/update.rs step 5). It is tried again at the next call.
5. A room whose GroupInfo/fetch the hub refuses (notAuthorized, noSuchRoom), or that fails the check in 3, is not tried again until the agent restarts (kept in memory), so a left room's unbound Chat does not cost a request per sync.
6. Messages of epochs before the one the device joined in are skipped quietly: the device cannot decrypt them and history is not shared (state.json Room.joined_epoch).
7. Trigger: Agent::join_own_rooms, called by mimid-agent-jmap's sync after invites are accepted, every sync.
8. Room policy: room-policy-04 §8.1.1 canAddOwnClient covers "add its own client (via an external commit ...)", and the hub checks it both on /groupInfo and on the external Commit. Decision mimid-1wgh.56 item 4 gave it to neither member nor admin; that part is superseded: both default roles now hold canAddOwnClient. base_room_policy multi_device was already true. Rooms hosted before keep their roles_list, so new devices cannot join them until an admin changes the role list.
9. did_webvh rooms: Member::join_external raises the joiner's own entry in the did_webvh record in the same external Commit (decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.33), so a device the user's log authorizes can join; one the log does not authorize fails MLS validation at the other members.
